findings.title: Ignored documents bypass cross-checkout write protection
findings.description: `git status --porcelain` omits ignored, untracked files, but document discovery includes them. Such a document passes readiness and is rewritten in another checkout. `commitPathsIfChanged` then also sees empty status and returns `null`, leaving the write uncommitted without a deferral or error. Explicitly detect and defer ignored targets before writing, and add regression coverage.

findings.title: Commit timeout can report committed fixes as rolled back
findings.description: A slow `post-commit` hook can time out after Git has already advanced HEAD. This handler restores from that new HEAD, then reports `COMMIT_FAILED` and removes successful fix logs, although the fixes remain committed. Capture the original HEAD and reconcile whether the commit landed before declaring rollback. Add a post-commit timeout test alongside the rejecting pre-commit test.
